description: PAG Strassen is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Affaires intérieures. The general development plan (‘GAP’) consists of a graphic and written part. In general, the data are made available in the form of a ‘ZIP’ file. The graphical part of the PAG is provided in "GML" format in accordance with the provisions of the Ministerial Regulation of 1 July 2016. Coverage: Ministère des Affaires intérieures. The publisher named on the listing is Ministère des Affaires intérieures. Its keywords include strassen, communes, developpement, urban, development, pap. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
